MAIN.description:
'VARDZIA RESORT'  is located in the Javakheti region of  Georgia, 240 kilometers from the capital Tbilisi. The spectacular design of the resort ensures that almost every one of the resort’s 32 rooms and 7 cottage rooms enjoys a view of the Beautiful nature and Vardzia Cave Town.

Here, each season is distinctively unique, ideal for relaxation, family reunions, weddings, business meetings, retreats, corporate, entertainment and sports events. We invite you to experience breathtaking nature, elegant and contemporary hotel and a unique atmosphere that provides privacy and tranquility.
Enjoy stupendous calm and peace of location and choose harmony and well-being over the chaotic pace of today’s lifestyle.
The recreation area includes following facilities:

   • Hotel/32 rooms+7 cottage rooms 
   • Two Restaurants 
   • Lounge Bar 
   • Two Conference Halls 
   • Spa Centre 
   • Two Swimming Pools 
   • Fitness hall

Our focus for attention to every detail and to satisfy all our customer needs creates a comfortable atmosphere that makes our guests feel at home, to relax and enjoy their stay.
VARDZIA RESORT has 32 rooms on average 20-30 square meters each.

The hotel offers Standard, Junior Suite, Suite, Family and cottage rooms.

   • Private balconies 
   • Seating area  
   • Mini-bar 
   • Free Wi-Fi 
   • Hairdryer, bathrobes and slippers 
   • Hygienic supplies 
   • Flat-screen TV 
   • Work desk 
   • Free Coffee & Tea 

There are two restaurants and bars located on the resort territory. The buffet accommodated for up to 150 people, offers traditional food choice and essential plates served with wine chosen from our wine cellar. Guests are able to appreciate Georgian local cuisine and taste exotic national dishes.
The food at VARDZIA RESORT is always fresh, organic and natural, locally produced at the resort. As regards to the bars, our famous shakers are always ready to surprise you with a variety of exotic drinks and unique cocktails.

Conference halls at VARDZIA RESORT are perfect for corporate conferences and other business events. The service includes organizing coffee and lunch breaks. We offer our guests unique ambience, high quality service and affordable prices.

Discover the most interesting and memorable activities that VARDZIA RESORT recommends to its guests. Resort is ideally located to access the main historical, cultural, famous and picturesque sites of the region. Hotel’s Adventure Center is determined for guests who desire to enjoy their holidays and participate in various kinds of extreme, cultural and wine tours that can be personalized upon the request.
MAIN.title: Vardzia Resort

BAR_RESTAURANT.description:
National and Meskhetian cuisine

The restaurant is at your service

Separately from the hotel situated cozy restaurant of Georgian cuisine, which is available for every traveler-pilgrim  will surprise  with the quality of  food and reasonable prices.

The uniqueness of our kitchen  is that it also offers local dishes  of  Meskheti cooked on an open fire and mountain spring water. Meals are prepared from organic products grown at local farms. Lovers  of modern drinks, cocktails and pleasant music can relax in the bar.

The restaurant can accommodate a large number of visitors, who can dine inside the restaurant (130 persons) and on the large terrace (150 persons), enjoying the views of the Vardzia cave city.

Restaurant is open from 11:00 till 23:00.

Delicious, juicy, fragrant, spicy, moderately hot – this is just a small list of epithets that Georgian cuisine can be rewarded.  However, when talking about it for some reason, one immediately imagine “shashlik”  (barbecue), plenty of greenery and a lot of wine. In fact it is  not exactly this way

Lounge Bar with Karaoke - 0pen from 14:00 till 02:00
BAR_RESTAURANT.title: Bar & Restaurant

BISHI_BAR.description:
Discover the authentic flavors of Meskheti at Bishi Bar.

If the aroma of freshly prepared specialties and the sound of soft music draw you in, you’ve found the perfect place to relax and enjoy a true local experience.

We serve freshly made Bishi and Lukhumi, alongside a selection of traditional Meskhetian delicacies.

Bishi is a beloved traditional Meskhetian flatbread, freshly prepared and served hot.
BISHI_BAR.title: Bishi Bar

DINNING_ROOM.description:
Georgian Cuisine Hits

The Georgian cuisine is one of the most original cuisines of the world. You can acquaint yourself with the culinary traditions of Georgian cuisine and personally take part in the preparation of national dishes in the Vardzia Resort restaurant.

 Thanks to our chefs,  visitors will have a unique opportunity to join in an atmosphere imbued with the Georgian spirit and enjoy the flavors  of herbs and spices used to prepare national dishes of the peoples of  Georgia.
DINNING_ROOM.title: Hotel Dinery

LOUNGE.description:
The best  place for gatherings Lounge Bar

Lounge Bar is the unique place for gatherings in a small circle of friends, family vacation or for a big party. If you want to relax in a summer/winter cafe in nature - visit us! Cafe-Bar with a patio and an outdoor terrace always attracts a lot of visitors, and in the summer, its popularity grows  significantly.

It’s great to escape from the dusty noisy city streets for a while, to find yourself  in the grace of the quiet shady aisles,  to breathe the cool air near waters.  One of the undeniable advantages of cafe in nature is the opportunity to sit at a table on the patio or terrace and enjoy a beautiful landscape. Here you can also prepare by yourself and enjoy your favourite barbecue.
LOUNGE.title: Lobby Lounge

VIEWS.description:
From the resort grounds, you can enjoy beautiful views of the Vardzia Monastery Complex and the Mtkvari River Valley. Here, you can fully unwind, surrounded by the tranquility of nature and the soothing sounds of the Mtkvari River and its surroundings.

The resort grounds also feature the 9th–10th-century Chapel of Saint Marine, caves discovered on the property, a vineyard, terraces, and artificial pools.
VIEWS.title: Views

MAIN.description:
The history of VardziaResort began long before 2015, when the resort welcomed its first guests.

The idea of attracting tourists to Samtskhe-Javakheti was already on the mind of Nikoloz Natenadze in the 1930s and 1940s. A lawyer by profession, public figure, Rustvelologist and restorer, he made a significant contribution to the development and promotion of the Vardzia Monastery Complex.

At a time when parts of Vardzia’s caves had been turned into livestock shelters by Turkish shepherds, Nikoloz Natenadze laid the foundations for their restoration and preservation.

In 1936–1937, large-scale restoration works were carried out in Vardzia under his initiative: more than 300 caves were cleared, the Church of the Dormition of the Virgin Mary and its frescoes were restored, and archaeologists discovered a pharmacy dating back to the time of Queen Tamar. He became the first director of the Vardzia Tourist Complex and Museum, both of which he had established, and played a key role in their development.

Nikoloz Natenadze’s work extended beyond Vardzia. In 1934, an expedition was organized to study the potential construction of hydroelectric power stations in the Mtkvari River valley. Through his efforts, a water supply system was also built for the village of Gogasheni, which locals still call “Kolia’s Water” to this day.

It was Nikoloz Natenadze’s dedication to saving the rock-hewn city of Vardzia that inspired his descendants to continue the work he had begun. For them, this meant contributing to the cultural and economic development of Vardzia itself and of the Samtskhe-Javakheti region as a whole.

To this day, he is remembered as “the man who saved Vardzia.”
MAIN.title: Family History

The modern system of video communication and simultaneous translation allows to conduct international forums as well any kind of business meetings in the hall. Stereoscopic projection system allows you to demonstrate films and arrange colourful presentations. The conference room is 90sq.m. and is supposed for 40 participants.

The modern conference room is a workspace, which ensures a  significant part of the success of a business event. If you need space, silence and involvement of  participants in a business event - our comfortable and well-equipped conference rooms will be the best choice. Spend a pleasant evening in a fun atmosphere with friends, surrounded by fellow enthusiasts of these exciting games.

With elegant interiors, versatile event spaces, refined service, and personalized details, we provide all the key elements to make your event truly exceptional. Our experienced team ensures every aspect is carefully planned and flawlessly executed, so that each moment is unique and memorable.
EVENTS.title: Weddings and Events

GARDEN.description:
The complex is located in a stunning garden, established on restored historical terraces and the surrounding valley area. These terraces are home to a variety of local fruit trees—including cornelian cherry, mulberry, walnut, medlar, sour cherry, plum, cherry plum, apricot, hazelnut, currant, raspberry, blackberry, bladdernut, and more—whose blooming and ripening seasons make the resort especially attractive throughout the year.

A vineyard of Meskhetian grape varieties, planted on the terraces, blends harmoniously into the garden’s landscape design, which has been developed in line with modern trends. Rare conifer species are complemented by century-old cornelian cherry and walnut trees. At any time of year, you can enjoy a rich collection of roses, peonies, tulips, irises, asters, and dahlias.
GARDEN.title: Garden

OUTDOOR_POOLS.title: Outdoor Pools

ROOSTERS.description:
During your stay at Vardzia Resort, you’ll find colorful rugs featuring rooster motifs almost everywhere.

Dating back to the 1930s–1950s, these rugs are part of Georgia’s textile heritage. Traditionally handmade by women in old Georgian households, each rug stands out through its unique combination of colors, ornaments, and intricate details.

In Georgian decorative art, the rooster represents courage and strength. Its vibrant colors and diverse designs are what make these rugs truly special.

Today, more than 100 rooster rugs are displayed throughout Vardzia Resort.
ROOSTERS.title: Roosters

SPA.description: After a day of exploring, Vardzia Resort’s spa offers a peaceful space to unwind and recharge. Enjoy our wet and dry saunas, jacuzzi, and cold plunge, thoughtfully combined to create a complete spa experience.

WINERY.description:
Wine tasting in our wine cellar

Our wine tasting is focused on wine lovers and anyone who wants to join this culture, to acquire new knowledge and emotions.

You will learn to understand what is a good wine and to choose right gastronomic combinations. We offer several type of local wines for tasting and appetizers prepared by our chef, that  will help you unleash the true taste of these wines and to appreciate them.

Wine for two

For your romantic evening our sommelier will select the perfect combination of food and drinks. You only need to select one from the options, and enjoy wine, food and festive atmosphere. The evening’s program includes: a bottle of white, red or sparkling wine, creative cuisine from the Apartments brand-chef, sommelier’s  story about the wine and  basic rules of tasting.
WINERY.title: Winery
